description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Salvager of Secrets.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Salvager of Secrets from exile to the battlefield.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
